name: mech-53-fog-tile-room
source: mech-53-fog-tile Test Level: lit room with fog along the south wall (FFFf at y=5) and the gate's last orb inside the fog at (4,5); visible orb at (6,1) on the entrance row; walking the clear middle floor (y=3, two tiles from the fog) reaches the gate at (11,1) one orb short and reveals nothing, coming back along the wall (y=4, adjacent to the fog) reveals the fog, collecting its orb, then the gate opens to the warp
